title: Autumn Sparkle Robe Hook, 2-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Bathroom Hook, 2.64-In Projection, Malibu, Allied Brass
description: Robe hook for bathroom storage and daily use, sized 2 inches (2-inch, 2in) L x 2 inches H with 2.64 inches (2.64-inch, 2.64in) projection — available in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round. Wall mount / wall-mounted brass hook made from solid brass materials, designed as a bathroom robe hook and towel hook for hanging robes, towels, and accessories. Includes color coordinated mounting hardware; no assembly required. Weight capacity: 2 lb. Contemporary Malibu collection styling for designer bathroom hardware, contemporary bath accessories, statement bath accessories, and sculptural fixtures; ideal for matching Malibu layouts across the bath.  and backed by a limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Malibu collection.
